name: SXSW
description: South by Southwest — film, music, and interactive tech. Key for emerging media trends, IP announcements, and cross-industry talent moves.

name: GDC
description: Game Developers Conference — the industry's primary technical and creative gathering. Key for art pipeline announcements, engine updates, and studio hiring signals.

name: Nordic Game
description: Europe's premier games industry conference. Strong signal for European studio moves and emerging IP from the Nordic/Baltic region.

name: Origins Game Fair
description: Major tabletop gaming convention covering TTRPG, board games, and miniatures. Key for tracking TTRPG IP launches and publisher announcements.

name: Annecy Animation Festival
description: The world's leading animation festival. Critical for tracking animated IP, art direction trends, and co-production deals relevant to Twinfang's character art pipeline.

name: ChinaJoy
description: China's largest digital entertainment expo. Key signal for Asian market trends, mobile art styles, and Chinese studio expansion into global markets.

name: SIGGRAPH
description: Premier conference for computer graphics, animation, and VFX. Key for tracking rendering advances, AI art tools, and real-time technology affecting the art pipeline.

name: Gen Con
description: North America's largest tabletop RPG and board game convention. Essential for TTRPG market tracking, IP announcements, and publisher health signals.

name: Devcom
description: Developer-focused conference held just before Gamescom. Key for European studio relationships, outsourcing pipeline discussions, and art production tech.

name: Gamescom
description: World's largest gaming event by attendance. Key for AAA title reveals, partnership announcements, and European publisher deal-making.

name: Trojan Horse was a Unicorn
description: Premier gathering for digital artists in games, film, and animation. Directly relevant to Twinfang — talent acquisition, art direction trends, AI art discourse, and competitor studio exposure.

name: PAX West
description: Major consumer gaming convention with indie and AA presence. Useful for consumer sentiment signals and indie studio deal-watching.

name: Tokyo Game Show
description: Japan's largest gaming convention. Key for Japanese studio announcements, Asian market IP releases, and anime/manga-influenced art direction trends.

name: XDS
description: External Development Summit — the primary conference focused on game outsourcing and co-development. Directly relevant to Twinfang's business model; key for client prospecting and competitor positioning.

name: PAX Unplugged
description: Tabletop-focused PAX event. Useful for TTRPG publisher tracking and board game IP announcements.

name: PAX East
description: East Coast gaming convention. Strong indie and mid-tier developer presence; useful for emerging studio tracking.

name: Sundance Film Festival
description: Premier independent film festival. Key for animated short trends, IP that may migrate to games, and broader entertainment industry sentiment.

name: PAX Australia
description: Asia-Pacific gaming convention. Useful for tracking Australian and Southeast Asian studio activity.

name: GameStart Asia
description: Southeast Asia's leading consumer and trade games expo. Key regional event for tracking SEA market trends, local publisher activity, and regional studio visibility.

name: Gamescom Asia
description: Gamescom's Asian edition, held in Bangkok. Directly relevant to Twinfang — regional client prospecting, SEA publisher presence, and Southeast Asian studio networking. Robby attending.

name: Thai Game Show
description: Thailand's largest gaming expo, held at BITEC. Key for visibility into the Thai and broader SEA consumer gaming market and local developer ecosystem.

name: Level Up KL
description: Malaysia's premier game developer conference covering business, design, and art. Strong SEA developer presence — useful for regional talent and partnership conversations.

name: IGDX
description: Indonesia Game Developers Exchange — the primary gathering for Indonesian game developers and regional industry stakeholders. Directly relevant to Twinfang's home market.

name: Develop:Brighton
description: UK's leading game developer conference. Strong art and outsourcing track — useful for European client prospecting and pipeline best-practice talks.
